name: selection-manipulator
description: The ultimate text processing toolkit for VS Code. Over 700 tools: extract, sort, unique, JSON/XML format, case conversion, encryption (AES), hashing (SHA/MD5), base64, network tools (DNS), Japanese text conversion, and ASCII art.

selection-manipulator.date.timeZones.description: IANA time zones listed by "Date - Show in Multiple Time Zones" (1 to 20 names such as UTC, Asia/Tokyo or America/Los_Angeles).

selection-manipulator.date.weekdayLangua.description: Language of the weekday added by "Date - Append Weekday".

selection-manipulator.date.fiscalYearSta.description: First month (1-12) of the fiscal year used by "Date - Show Quarter and Fiscal Year".
